children: lululemon athletica inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with net revenue of $2.42B, net income of $329.22M and diluted EPS of $2.92, down versus the year-ago quarter as revenue and earnings declined.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue trend: Net revenue declined about 4% year over year in Q2, driven by an 8% decline in the Americas while China and Rest‑of‑World showed modest growth.
Comparable sales & channel mix: Global comparable sales fell 9% in Q2 due to lower store traffic and conversion; e‑commerce partially offset in-store weakness.
Margin & costs: Gross margin expanded roughly 200 basis points in Q2, largely reflecting IEEPA tariff refunds, while occupancy and distribution costs increased.
Store footprint: Opened a net 14 company‑operated stores in Q2 across China and RoW, bringing the total store count to 825.
Operational priorities: Management is focused on product creation, activation and enterprise enablement to drive full‑price sales recovery.
